newsitem.title: USA: Netvantage sees Q2 loss on inventory sale.
newsitem.headline: Netvantage sees Q2 loss on inventory sale.

text.p: Network equipment company NetVantage Inc on Monday said it anticipates a second-quarter loss of between $2.5 million and $3.2 million.

In a release, the company attributed the expected losses to a decision to sell off certain inventory at negative margins to avoid more substantial losses if that inventory were allowed to become stale or obsolete.
The company recorded a net loss of $1.5 million in its 1996 second quarter.

Netvantage also said it sees second quarter revenues between $5.6 million and $6.0 million, up from $4.8 million for the second quarter of 1996, and nearly double the $3.3 million reported for the first quarter ended March 31, 1997.
The company also said that it entered the third quarter with a backlog exceeding $3 million.
